description: Rewrites an existing e-invoice in another syntax, for example CII to UBL, or plain EN 16931 to XRechnung or Peppol BIS. Use it when you already hold an invoice document. To build one from data use create_invoice; to get a PDF from XML use parse_invoice, then create_invoice_pdf. Accepts XML or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF. Nothing is invented: a target such as XRechnung may need data the source lacks, so read `warnings` and run validate_invoice on the result. A document it cannot read comes back as an error result with the reason. Runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere.

pdfBase64.description: A Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 as base64; the embedded XML is used. Provide this OR xml.

to.description: Output syntax. "cii" = UN/CEFACT CII, EN 16931 (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD EN 16931 profile, a.k.a. COMFORT); "cii-extended" = UN/CEFACT CII declared as Factur-X / ZUGFeRD EXTENDED (EN 16931 content only; no EXTENDED-only fields); "ubl" = UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote, EN 16931; "xrechnung-cii" = XRechnung 3.x in CII syntax (German CIUS); "xrechnung-ubl" = XRechnung 3.x in UBL syntax (German CIUS); "peppol-ubl" = Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL); "ksef-fa3" = Polish KSeF FA(3), PLN domestic invoices only; written and schema-checked, never submitted.

xml.description: The invoice as XML text (CII, UBL Invoice/CreditNote, XRechnung, Peppol BIS). Provide this OR pdfBase64.

name: convert_invoice

from.description: Syntax of the source: cii, ubl-invoice or ubl-credit-note.

warnings.description: Non-fatal findings, e.g. data the target requires that the source does not have.

xml.description: The invoice in the target syntax.

title: Convert an e-invoice between syntaxes
